lxc_360960aebe06b1a0.text: Video games are fun, but they are also products made by people.

lxc_e7d23336201c4cda.text: Some games cost money before you play, while others are free to start.

lxc_a1adde7cee09039e.text: Both kinds need income to keep working.

lxc_a366c17ae3c036d1.text: Their business choices can also affect how players spend real money.

lxc_9a89bf17a992f71b.text: A game needs a team and technology.

lxc_7ce22c068a9de92b.text: Other workers test the game, answer players, and fix problems.

lxc_b98d7d652ee4ea98.text: Online games also need computers called servers so people can play together.

lxc_218f4eb341c5c894.text: A company can ask players to buy a game before playing.

lxc_5e377e7748b424e7.text: Another game can be free to start and sell extra things later.

lxc_4aa829342ec2b170.text: Free-to-play does not mean the game has no business plan.

lxc_53309cc090c56125.text: The company still needs income to pay its costs and continue its work.

lxc_a73574a346ed53d1.text: Many games have a store inside them.

lxc_e9783778a7eb0999.text: Official Fortnite information says players can use V-Bucks for Battle Passes, cosmetics, and other items.

lxc_72add919acfeed10.text: It also describes the Item Shop, outfits, and emotes.

lxc_7d24e956283f7e37.text: V-Bucks are a virtual currency used in Fortnite.

lxc_3ff8395808bb4c17.text: Roblox has a Marketplace where users can find and buy items for a customizable avatar.

lxc_bf7e55384dd505c2.text: Roblox creator information also explains purchases made with Robux.

lxc_a08ee081ec81c62e.text: A skin or outfit can make a character feel more personal.

lxc_754d0ee9f355be0c.text: However, a digital item is not a physical toy that you can hold.

lxc_c9ed906d834c3522.text: Virtual currency can make the real cost less easy to notice, so it helps to check the price carefully.

lxc_085feba1ab3b5f0c.text: Games can earn money in several other ways.

lxc_29c136587bb46d68.text: Roblox creator information describes passes that give a player a special privilege after one payment.

lxc_3bf9288f031ceeeb.text: It also describes subscriptions with a payment each month and immersive ads inside an experience.

lxc_bf130379d474fd1d.text: Fortnite documentation describes the Battle Pass as a way to unlock cosmetics, V-Bucks, and other items.

lxc_4738ecc43ae3a62d.text: Rewarded ads are common in phone games.

lxc_06f3da81b10fd0de.text: A player chooses to watch a short ad and receives coins or an extra life.

lxc_970e530b49ffa7e9.text: The advertiser pays to show the ad, and part of that money goes to the game business.

lxc_179dcbea97447700.text: Together, these examples show how video games make money without charging every player in the same way.

lxc_1f9f575cef696765.text: A game may run a limited-time event and offer a special character or item.

lxc_c33ce7b449bfa42d.text: The short time can make the item feel rare.

lxc_7fe4e4e85dc2a5f7.text: Players may worry that they will miss their chance.

lxc_a4ea03bdad8fbb41.text: This feeling is often called FOMO, or fear of missing out.

lxc_3da5c13b4f66ceb7.text: A timer tells you when an offer ends, but it does not mean you need the item.

lxc_ecba49542c8ce4b1.text: The item might return later, or it might not.

lxc_70783a3e0810489d.text: Game companies use events to bring players back and show them new offers.

lxc_746724b70c6e90f2.text: A useful choice is to pause, check the real price, and decide after the first excitement becomes quieter.

lxc_f3cd0e62ca693ab7.text: New maps, characters, missions, and rewards give players a reason to return.

lxc_c8137422d35ae4ca.text: When more people play for longer, they also have more chances to see a store or an ad.

lxc_e0718f2c6490adf1.text: Updates can therefore support both the fun of a game and its business.

lxc_55925a1e2312542c.text: Before spending, set a budget and ask a few questions.

lxc_a341335bc123e60d.text: Do I really want this, or am I reacting to FOMO?

lxc_2379bcd123386b85.text: Will I use this pass often?

lxc_3bdbc5ef1308a2b0.text: What else could I buy with the same real money?

lxc_42d45efbd29dde77.text: A child can also ask a parent or another trusted adult.

lxc_8a63a07ec200fc6a.text: A skin may be worth it to one player and not worth it to another.
